summary: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that management will present at two upcoming investor conferences: Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference (August 11-12, 2026) and Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference (August 11-13, 2026). Presenters include CEO Adi Sfadia and CFO Gil Benyamini. The filing is a routine disclosure of investor conference participation, containing no strategic transaction, corporate action, or special situation. It is purely informational, with no deal terms, pricing, or board actions. This is not a special situation; the appropriate classification is 'None'.
